activity.notes: Zhang Jue (Zhang Jiao) already exists in ATLAS with a legacy Eastern Han activity. This additional Activity supplies the missing own-side political-military community: in 184 he launched and led the Yellow Turban uprising and styled himself General of Heaven. The existing Eastern Han record is retained; no deletion is performed.

sources.title: The Yellow Turban Rebellion — Chinese Text Project Data Wiki
sources.citation_text: The Chinese Text Project summary records Zhang Jiao's Taiping movement, his organization of the revolt and the outbreak of the Yellow Turban rebellion in 184.
